print(f"January ratio: {ratio_jan:.6f}")
print(f"February ratio: {ratio_feb:.6f}")
print(f"March ratio: {ratio_mar:.6f}")

# Months as x values (1, 2, 3)
x1, x2, x3 = 1, 2, 3
y1, y2, y3 = ratio_jan, ratio_feb, ratio_mar

# Calculate means

mean_y = (y1 + y2 + y3) / 3

print(f"\nMean x: {mean_x}")
print(f"Mean y: {mean_y}")

# Calculate slope using formula: sum((xi - mean_x)(yi - mean_y)) / sum((xi - mean_x)^2)

denominator = (x1 - mean_x)**2 + (x2 - mean_x)**2 + (x3 - mean_x)**2

slope = numerator / denominator

# Calculate intercept: b = mean_y - slope * mean_x
intercept = mean_y - slope * mean_x

print(f"\nLinear Regression Results:")
